items.heading: Kisra with Stew
details: Key ingredients: sorghum flatbread, meat, tomato, onion
Ferment a thin sorghum batter, then cook it on a hot griddle into a large flatbread.
Simmer meat with tomato and onion into a rich stew.
Cook until the meat is tender and the sauce thickens.
Serve the flatbread alongside the stew for scooping.

items.heading: Ful Sudani (South Sudanese Style)
details: Key ingredients: fava beans, onion, tomato, oil
Simmer fava beans until soft.
Mash lightly, leaving some texture.
Stir in sauteed onion and tomato.
Serve warm with bread.
